NOTE
**Still not ready**

|     |         |
| --- | ------- |
| ❌  | Remove "Fixes a part of …" from all commit messages (messages are unchanged since the feedback) |
| ❌  | Put "Fixes: #16094" in the last commit, after the description (commit messages unchanged) |
| ⚠️  | Precise before/after screenshots: the description still shows the same screenshots, so it's unclear whether they were trimmed to the changed text |
| ℹ️  | CI status is unknown, and the PR description still says "Fixes part of: #16094" |

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and ask the author to fix the commit messages and confirm the screenshots.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks @Amormio25! The commit messages still look unchanged: please remove "Fixes a part of …" from all of them and put "Fixes: #16094" in the last commit, after the description (see the [commit discipline guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/version-control.html#commit-messages)). Please also trim the screenshots to only the changed text, per the [precise before/after guidelines](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/presenting-visual-changes.html#what-are-precise-before-after-screenshots).
```
